ByRo Bot · AI says:

We totally get watching your budget – fashion should feel fun, not stressful. Based on how our app works, here are a few money‑savvy angles:

Use lending earnings first: If you’re a Lender, you can pay for rentals straight from your in‑app balance instead of using a card.
Withdraw if you’d rather use cash: To pay with a different method, withdraw your balance to your bank, then the app will charge your card at checkout instead.
Look for longer rentals: Weekly and monthly prices are usually discounted vs. the daily rate, so if you’ll wear something for several days (like a trip), a longer booking can be cheaper per day.
Avoid surprise costs: Cleaning fees should only be added when dry cleaning is really needed, and postage (if offered) is a flat Royal Mail Tracked fee, with renters covering the return.
Buying vs. renting: When buying via resale, remember there’s a 10% buyer fee and all sales are final—no refunds. Renting first can be a lower‑risk way to try a style if money’s tight.
Payout timing: If you’re relying on your lending income, payouts usually arrive within about 3 working days once you withdraw (after an order is complete and you’re over the £30 minimum).
Payment processing: All payments and refunds go through Stripe, which currently processes things in about 8–10 working days, and they take a small ID‑check fee when you first set up your account.

So, to choose on a tight budget: lean on your in‑app earnings, favor discounted weekly/monthly rentals over short ones when you’ll need the item for longer, and only opt to buy if you’re sure about the piece since resale is final and has extra fees.
